newsitem.title: UK: Turkey buys at least 50,000 t heating oil - trade.
newsitem.headline: Turkey buys at least 50,000 t heating oil - trade.

text.p: Turkish state oil company Tupras has awarded two cargoes of 0.5 percent sulphur heating oil totalling at least 50,000 tonnes, traders said on Monday.
One cargo went to Agip for delivery January 1-5 into Iskanderun at around average fob quotes +$9, traders said. One went to Tempotrade for December 20-25 into Izmit at about average fob quotes +$8.
Tupras awarded a third, optional cargo to Galaxy for January 5-10 into Izmit at average fob quotes +$8.97, traders said. All the cargoes are for at least 25,000 tonnes.
